subject: Proposed deep-dive slots and attendee confirmation
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@wellpath.com>, Priya Shah <priya@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-07T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed deep-dive slots and attendee confirmation

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the great discovery conversation earlier — appreciate the context on ingestion patterns and retention needs. To keep momentum, we'd like to schedule the architecture deep-dive (30–45 min technical walkthrough + 15 min Q&A). Two options that work for our engineers: 

- Tue, Oct 12 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed, Oct 13 — 14:00–15:00 PT

Could you confirm which of those is better for your team? If neither works, share 2–3 windows and we’ll adjust. Also, please confirm the attendee list from your side so we include the right folks. Based on our discovery, proposed attendees:

- Alex Morgan — Product Manager
- Priya Shah — Head of Integrations
- Jared Lim — Platform Architect (if available)

We’ll have Marcus Lin (inference runtime lead) and Dev Patel (solutions engineer) on our side. I’m attaching a short DeepDive Prep checklist and a draft mutual action plan to help guide the session.

Once you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link (we can include Google Meet as a fallback).

Quick ask: if you have any network/firewall constraints for Zoom or prefer Meet, note that in your reply so Marcus can bring alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: DeepDive-Prep-Checklist.pdf, MutualActionPlan.xlsx
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@wellpath.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Proposed deep-dive slots and attendee confirmation

Thanks, Soojin — great summary. Wed, Oct 13 14:00 PT works best for our group (that’s 17:00 ET for us).

FYI I’ll add Jared Lim (platform) to the thread — he’s our architect and will want to review network and key management details. Also, Priya will be on the call to talk integration points.

Zoom is fine for us; if you can send a calendar invite (Zoom preferred) we’ll accept and forward to a couple more internal stakeholders if needed.

Appreciate the prep docs.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Product Manager | Wellpath Health
alex.morgan@wellpath.com

Perfect — locking Wed, Oct 13 14:00–15:00 PT. Calendar invite sent (Google event ID: abc123def456) — please accept when you have a moment.

Join info: 
- Primary: Zoom (recommended)
  https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=redwood
- Fallback: Google Meet (if Zoom blocked)
  https://meet.google.com/lookup/redwood-wellpath

Attendee roster as currently listed on the invite: 
- Alex Morgan — Product Manager (Wellpath)
- Priya Shah — Head of Integrations (Wellpath)
- Jared Lim — Platform Architect (Wellpath)
- Soojin Lee — Enterprise Sales (Redwood) — organizer
- Marcus Lin — Inference Runtime Lead (Redwood)
- Dev Patel — Solutions Engineer (Redwood)

Attachments included on the event: DeepDive-Prep-Checklist.pdf, MutualActionPlan.xlsx. Marcus will lead the demo perimeter & runtime discussion; Dev will cover onboarding and infra checklist.

Pre-reads: please skim the prep checklist and add any items you’d like us to prioritize in the session (e.g., KMS/HSM, VPC peering, data retention). If you have a short network diagram for the platform we’ll read ahead of the call.

If any last-minute conflicts come up, reply-all and we’ll pivot.

Thanks — calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456

Best,
